interactiveMapsCity.title: Interactive Maps City
interactiveMapsCity.description: A collaborative map platform for city utility teams to plan, draw, and maintain infrastructure on shared workspaces. Multiple editors can work on the same map at once — with live cursors, instant updates, role-based access, and a nested project structure for organizing work at scale. Built for heavy use: large maps, many objects, and reliable backups with preview and restore, plus an admin panel for users, activity, and system oversight.
